# `get_json_object`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
get_json_object(json_txt, path)
```

Extracts a json object from `path`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `json_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- get_json_object, example 1
> SELECT get_json_object('{"a":"b"}', '$.a');
b
```

```sql
-- get_json_object, example 2
> SELECT get_json_object('[{"a":"b"},{"a":"c"}]', '$[0].a');
b
```

```sql
-- get_json_object, example 3
> SELECT get_json_object('[{"a":"b"},{"a":"c"}]', '$[*].a');
["b","c"]
```
